title: CE41015: Transients In Pipes And Open Channels
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Unsteady and transient flow analysis in pipe systems: water hammer: fundamental
equations, elastics waves in conduits, boundary effects, numerical and
graphical methods; other water conducting systems â surges in open channels and
forebays; pressure transients in tunnels, penstocks and peripheral components
(i.e., bends, reducers, branches, manifolds, anchor blocks); comparison of
static and transient pressures in water conducting systems; Types and basic
analysis through differential equations for surge tank, method of solution,
simple, and differential surge tanks with expanded chambers; Pipe network
analysis (steady state and transient); computer analysis and use of related
programs.
